rules.notes: RETIRED (direct-engagement policy, 2026-11-05): passive feed surfaces are never touched — no scroll, no redirect, no tap; auto-scrolling the user's page ruined the experience. Kept as documentation only (enabled=false) so the detection evidence is not lost. Original: IG feed reel/video cell: the video slot of a feed row (id video_container, class android.view.ViewGroup). Layer 1 (always hidden): swipes the cell upward out of view in place, so the feed stays usable and a relaunch does not land on the same autoplay cell. Evidence: 233205-ig_feed_scroll3 (+233157) show the id on a playing feed video while the bottom nav is present; 233005-ig_home (photo-only feed) and 233528-ig_reels_tab (clips viewer) do not contain the id, so it does not fire on photos or on the viewer. Runtime report scenarios 1 and 4 prove the old whole-app exit was unusable (launcher bounce loop); see docs/rules/RULES.md. LOCALE-PROOF: id video_container + ViewGroup class; no localized string is used.

IG Reels bottom-nav tab (id clips_tab, content-desc "Reels", class FrameLayout) — selected=true only on the Reels screen (233528), selected=false on feed/DM (233005, 234011), so the selected criterion narrows the rule to the blocked surface itself. TAP_HOME_TAB resolves the separate Home tab (id feed_tab) and clicks that, never the matched Reels node; the global Home action is only the last resort. The DM screen also stays shielded by ig_dm_carve_out (SKIP wins in RuleGate). Runtime report scenario 2 is the inverted-tap defect this replaces; see docs/rules/RULES.md. LOCALE-PROOF: id clips_tab + class FrameLayout + selected=true are the proof (identical on every UI language); content-desc "Reels" is an auxiliary hint only.

IG Reels/clips viewer (id clips_viewer_view_pager, class androidx.viewpager.widget.ViewPager; siblings clips_viewer_container / clips_viewer_video_layout also present). Layer 2 = the budget gate itself: RuleGate only neutralises layer 2 when the budget is exhausted or the nightly window is locked, which is exactly the analysis rule e-5 (never hijack the viewer during grace). Evidence 233528-ig_reels_tab (full tree captured while the viewer played). LOCALE-PROOF: the view id and ViewPager class are the whole key; no localized string is used.

IG DM carve-out: an open DM thread keeps its composer (id row_thread_composer_edittext, class EditText, hint "Message…"). SKIP outranks every neutralisation in RuleGate, so shared reels playing inside a thread are left alone. Evidence 234329-ig_dm_thread: thread with two shared reels on screen plus composer and direct_thread_* chrome; inbox bar direct_inbox_action_bar seen in 234011 (screenshot black: IG Direct is FLAG_SECURE). RE-VERIFIED 2026-11-07 on Reno4 / IG 454.0.0.54.77 / pt-PT: the thread still exposes the composer (hint "Enviar mensagem…") and the engine logs gate=SKIP (reverse/runtime-reno/flash-dm/04-ig-dm-thread.xml, 04-logcat-thread.txt); the DM list and the thread-with-keyboard expose it too. The reel opened *from* a thread is a different screen (no thread composer) and is covered by ig_dm_reel_carve_out. LOCALE-PROOF: the composer id + EditText class identify the thread on any UI language; the localized hint "Message…" is not used as a key.

IG DM carve-out, shared-reel screen (D13, 2026-11-07): tapping a shared reel inside a DM thread opens com.instagram.modal.TransparentModalActivity, whose tree has clips_viewer_view_pager (so ig_clips_viewer would escape it) and the DM reply composer reply_bar_edittext inside reel_viewer_message_composer, but NOT row_thread_composer_edittext — ig_dm_carve_out cannot see it. This SKIP rule shields that state, so the user can reply to the shared reel at 0 budget. Evidence: reverse/runtime-reno/flash-dm/12-ig-dm-reel-uia.xml and 08-ig-dm-reel-dump.json (53 nodes, pt-PT hint "Responde à tua própria mensagem", not a key) vs the pre-fix escape in 05-logcat.txt. NEGATIVE CONTROL: the normal Reels viewer (10-ig-reels-viewer-inbudget.xml) has clips_viewer_view_pager and no reply_bar_* node, so a non-DM viewer is never carved out and still escapes at 0 budget. LOCALE-PROOF: view id + AutoCompleteTextView class only.

RETIRED (direct-engagement policy, 2026-11-05): passive shelves are never touched — no scroll, no redirect, no tap; the feed is left exactly as the user found it. Kept as documentation only (enabled=false). Original: YT Shorts shelf on the Home feed. YouTube 21.43.523 exposes NO resource-ids on the shelf or the bottom nav (reel_recycler only exists in the player), so the shelf was matched on accessibility text: the shelf header ViewGroup content-desc "Shorts" and each shelf card ViewGroup content-desc "<title> - play Short" (234610-yt_home, en-US). Locale variants are alternate branches of the same regex — EN " - play Short" and pt " – reproduzir Short" (en dash, pt-yt-home3 on the Reno4, locale pt-PT); the header stays "Shorts" in both. RuleLookup already splits top-level alternation into literal queries, so no schema change. The bottom-nav Shorts entry is a Button, excluded by classNameRegex. The action swiped the shelf out of view in place instead of leaving the app. IG/TikTok PT variants are unauthored (no dump yet) — see docs/rules/RULES.md. LOCALE-PROOF STATUS: UNPROOFED — no dump shows a view id or distinctive structure for the shelf; the only non-string criterion left is the generic ViewGroup class, so every desc branch is a hint only. Do not re-enable without a structural/geometry anchor (see RULES.md).

YT Shorts player (id reel_recycler, class android.support.v7.widget.RecyclerView; reel_player_page_container and reel_watch_fragment_root are siblings). Layer 2: plays while the budget lasts, Back once exhausted/locked. Evidence 234810-yt_shorts_player, captured while a Short played. NOTE: the shorts_player_container id used by SocialLite 03c does not exist in 21.43.523 — do not key on it. LOCALE-PROOF: the view id and RecyclerView class are the whole key; no localized string is used.

match.contentDescriptionRegex: (?i)^for you$|like video\.|read or add comments|share video\.|add or remove this video from favorites

rules.notes: TikTok FYP player. LOCALE-PROOF PROOF (rule #271): the player container id player_view alone. RE-ANCHORED 2026-11-06 (on-device audit, Reno4 CPH2195 / Android 13 / pt-PT, TikTok 47.6.3): the previous key also required a video surface class (TextureView/SurfaceView/VideoView) and NEVER matched on this device — three playing-video dumps (reverse/runtime-reno/anchor-audit/tt-a-fresh-swipe.json, tt-b-midplay.json, tt-c-tap-focus.json) contain player_view visible at [0,110][1080,2121] and NO video surface node at all (the player renders into a child the accessibility tree does not expose), so the engine logged matched=0 while a video played. The class is now gone; player_view is present in every dump (4/4, incl. the tt-d-photo-post control). The FYP chrome descriptions (For You, Like video., Read or add comments, Share video., favourites) are AUXILIARY HINTS only: the pt-PT UI ('Para Ti', 'Comunidade') matches without them. Live is still excluded because a live preview has no player_view (235326 / the pt-PT sweep). The old anchor was id video_seek_bar, a player control that reports isVisibleToUser=false while a video plays (D2a) — never use it as the anchor; it is also the only tree difference between a video and a photo post on this build (present in all three video dumps, absent in tt-d-photo-post), so a photo carousel in the FYP now matches by id too — accepted, the surface is the FYP player either way, and DM-opened videos stay shielded by tiktok_dm_carve_out (SKIP). Layer 2: play while the budget lasts, one Back when exhausted.

TikTok DM carve-out: the in-thread composer button (id udm, class Button, text "Message <name>…") is present while a video shared in a DM plays full-screen — the exact screen where tiktok_playback would otherwise fire. SKIP wins in RuleGate. Evidence 001928-tt_dm_video_paused (player_view + the seek bar + "Message Carol...") and 001335-tt_activity_carol (chat thread with shared videos). The SocialLite strings "Back to chat"/"Reply privately" (03c f3348u0) do not occur in build 47.6.3; plain threads use composer id ui_slot_input_layout_redesign. LOCALE-PROOF: id udm + Button class identify the DM composer on any UI language; the localized "Message <name>…" text is an observable hint, never a key. See docs/rules/RULES.md.
